GenAiPlugin.description: Reads the current GTM Configurator page state — company name, industry, accent colour, object and dependency counts, health score, note, and the list of available industry keys. Call this first before suggesting any changes so you have the current values.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Call this action to read the current state of the GTM Configurator page. Pass the configId from the session variables if available; leave blank for unsaved sessions. Use the returned values to understand what is already set before proposing any updates. The availableIndustries list tells you which industry keys are valid for the industry field.
